items.title: Towards Restorative Urban Spaces: An Exploratory Field Study of Nature Videos on Public Multi-Display Signage
items.snippet: In recent years, multi-display signage (MDS) has become increasingly common in urban stations, plazas, and other public spaces, where it is primarily used to present advertisements and information. Beyond these conventional applications, MDS offers opportunities to shape people's experiences of public environments through spatially distributed and dynamic visual content. Motivated by the potential of mediated nature to support restorative experiences in urban environments, we conducted a nine-day exploratory field study in a free-admission area of a science museum, presenting artificial intell
items.summary: 最近の研究では、公共の多重表示サイネージ（MDS）が都市の駅や広場で普及しているにゃ。主に広告や情報を提供するために使われているが、MDSは人々の公共空間での体験を豊かにする可能性があるそうだにゃ。特に、自然を媒介とした体験が都市環境での癒しに寄与することが期待されているにゃん。
